election._note: D'Hondt in six twenty-seat districts with no statutory threshold; the three diaspora seats were abolished before 2024, leaving 120. Reduced to national D'Hondt with a 0.0 gate. Elected 8 May 2024, so the next is due by spring 2028. Electoral Code of North Macedonia; Wikipedia, '2024 North Macedonian parliamentary election'.

dissolution._note: The Sobranie dissolves itself by a majority of all deputies (Art. 63(6)) -- the template's self_dissolution read literally; elections follow within 60 days, run by the caretaker 'technical government' convention. Constitution of North Macedonia, Art. 63.

head_of_state._note: The President, directly elected for five years, two terms at most, with a 40% turnout requirement in the second round; elected May 2024, so the next falls in spring 2029. Largely ceremonial. Constitution of North Macedonia, Arts. 80-81.
head_of_state.title: President

amendment._note: Art. 131: two thirds of all deputies, with a double majority (two thirds AND a majority of the deputies of the non-majority communities) for the provisions the 2001 Ohrid Agreement entrenched -- the community lock is unmodelled. Constitution of North Macedonia, Art. 131.
amendment._referendum_note: No constitutional referendum is required; the 2018 name referendum was consultative and the change passed by Art. 131's parliamentary route. Constitution of North Macedonia, Art. 131.
amendment._permits_system_change_note: No eternity clause; the 2019 name change shows how far the Art. 131 route reaches.

judicial._note: A Constitutional Court reviews the constitutionality of laws (Arts. 108-113). Constitution of North Macedonia, Art. 110.

formation._note: The President gives the mandate to the largest party's candidate, and the Sobranie elects the government by a majority of all deputies (Art. 90); by convention the coalition includes an ethnic-Albanian party. No-confidence needs a majority of all deputies (Art. 92), read as simple_present. Constitution of North Macedonia, Arts. 90, 92.

government._pretender_note: Whom data/laws/amendments.json's Restoration Act puts on the throne. The modern state has never been a monarchy; the restored line is the house's invention, as MLT's is.

fiscal._note: General government, IMF/Ministry of Finance ~2024, rounded, on AUT.json's conventions. VAT 18% standard; corporate 10%; income 10% flat; capital gains 10%; no wealth tax. Revenue ~27% of GDP includes social contributions. Debt ~55% of GDP (end-2024). Pensions 9% is the heavy line of an ageing, emigrating population. Spending scaled to expenditure near 36% of GDP.
